create_RequestMetrics: create a RequestMetrics object to track pipeline stage timings and memory snapshots for a single request
build_StageProfiler: build a StageProfiler context manager to record execution time and memory snapshots for a named pipeline stage
run_PerformanceLogger_dump_benchmark_rep: run dump_benchmark_report to write a JSON benchmark report with stages, steps, and memory checkpoints to a file
run_PerformanceLogger_log_request_summar: run log_request_summary to append a request performance record as a JSON line to the performance log file
capture_memory_snapshot: capture a GPU memory snapshot with allocated, reserved, and peak values in megabytes
